description: This PHP source file defines the class SubPanelTilesTabs, which extends SubPanelTiles to handle the organization and display of subpanel tabs within the SuiteCRM (a SugarCRM extension). It manages layout definitions, user preferences for subpanel arrangements, and rendering of tabbed subpanels on detail views.

classes.name: SubPanelTilesTabs
classes.description: A class responsible for managing tabbed subpanel layouts in SuiteCRM, including arrangement, user customization, and rendering of subpanel tabs in detail views.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the subpanel tab layout with focus object and optional layout keys.

methods.name: getSubpanelGroupLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the user's preferred layout for a given subpanel group, considering localization.

methods.name: applyUserCustomLayoutToTabs
methods.description: Reorders the provided tabs array based on the user's custom layout preferences.

methods.name: getTabs
methods.description: Public interface that wraps the internal _getTabs method, for retrieving organized tabs with display options.

methods.name: _getTabs
methods.description: Core method that organizes subpanel IDs into tabs, applies user preferences, manages special cases, and prepares the tab display structure.
